data.body:
**Correction — my previous comment on this ticket was wrong.** The stale-store-HEAD diagnosis does not hold, and the FAIL is genuine.

I tested it and it was refuted three ways: `--ref` defaults to `origin/main` (not the store HEAD) per `rebar verify-completion --help`; re-running with an explicit `ref=d5c325a4170` still FAILed; and `16c9-a42d` / `5a31-8c91`, which PASSed, are equally unreachable from that stale HEAD and equally record `file_impact`. Disregard the earlier comment.

**The actual root cause: change 2993 satisfied 4 of 5 codebase criteria but missed one.** Criterion c01 requires `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` to mention that `pyproject.toml:353-356` pins the required uv version to `==0.12.7`. The doc does mention uv 0.12.7 at line 75 (prerequisites), but never cites `pyproject.toml` as the source of the pin — searching the file for `pyproject.toml` and `required-version` returned no matches.

Verifier findings at `ref=d5c325a4170dfee29af010164a1cc2e3289cdc83`: 2 unmet criteria, both `severity: high` — c01 itself, and the derived "bug is actually resolved" criterion. The `pip install .[agents,reviewbot]` replacement, the four-service topology, the host-side nginx statement, and the ADR 0007 preservation all passed, as did the `[non-codebase]` verify-suite criterion.

**Remediation in flight.** Worktree `fix-1d89-uv-pin-ref` at `origin/main`. The section-5 compose paragraph now reads `uv sync --locked --no-dev --extra agents --extra reviewbot --extra bedrock`, with `pyproject.toml:353-356` pinning the required uv version to `==0.12.7`. Confirmed against the tree first: `required-version = "==0.12.7"` sits at `pyproject.toml:356`, inside the cited range. `make verify` running; Gerrit change to follow.

The async surface's failure to expose these findings is filed as `selective-dermic-coelacanth` (c6fb-49cf).
